items.rationale: Covered as necessary investigation to locate the source of water damage (7.1.7e, 2.4.2). Reference cases (esp. 27, 34) show this is indemnified at a substantial flat rate.
Covered as necessary measurement to establish extent of moisture (7.1.7e). Reference cases (21, 62, 65) show this is always indemnified.
Labour for covered investigation/repair is indemnified at customary rates (7.1.7g). Reference cases and price prior support this.
Assisting labour for covered work is indemnified at customary rates (7.1.7g). Reference cases and price prior support this.
One travel/call-out charge per contractor per invoice is indemnified (7.1.7f). Reference cases and price prior support this.
Consumables for covered work are indemnified (7.1.7c). Reference cases and price prior support this.
Necessary to access and repair affected pipe (7.1.7a). Reference cases (21, 62, 65) show this is indemnified.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation (0.75 hrs)
items.rationale: Removal of wet insulation from affected area is covered (7.1.7a, 7.1.5). Price prior for 0.75 hr applies.

items.description: Removal and disposal of damaged insulation (6 hrs)
items.rationale: Removal of wet insulation from affected area is covered (7.1.7a, 7.1.5). Price prior for 6 hr applies.

items.description: Room drying up to 25 m² (roof space)
items.rationale: Roof space was not affected by this insured event (7.1.5, 7.1.8f). Reference cases (65, 21, 62) show such lines are not indemnified.
Drying equipment for affected kitchen is covered (7.1.7b, 7.1.5). Reference cases and price prior support this.
Roof space was not affected by this insured event (7.1.5, 7.1.8f). Reference cases show such lines are not indemnified.
Drying of affected kitchen is covered (7.1.7b, 7.1.5). Reference cases (21, 62, 65) show this is indemnified.

items.description: Pipe repair, copper pipe 22–28 mm (1 m)
items.rationale: Repair of damaged pipe is covered (7.1.7c, 2.4.2). Reference cases (21, 62, 65) show this is indemnified.
Necessary fittings for pipe repair are covered (7.1.7c). Reference cases (21, 62, 56) show this is indemnified.
Replacement pipe for affected section is covered (7.1.7c). Reference cases (56, 40) show this is indemnified.
Replacement insulation for affected section is covered (7.1.7c). Reference cases (56, 40) show this is indemnified.
Labour for covered repair is indemnified at customary rates (7.1.7g). Reference cases and price prior support this.
Labour to restore insulation on affected pipes is covered (7.1.7c, g). Reference cases support this.
Final moisture measurement to confirm drying is covered (7.1.7e). Reference cases and price prior support this.
Cleaning of the covered work area is indemnified (7.1.7h). Reference cases and price prior support this.

items.description: Removal of the water-damaged wooden kitchen table
items.rationale: Removal of furnishing item destroyed by insured event is covered (7.1.7h, 4.2.6). Reference cases and price prior support this.
Transport away of destroyed furnishing item is covered (7.1.7h). Reference cases (21, 62) show this is indemnified.
Disposal of destroyed furnishing item is covered (7.1.7h). Reference cases (21, 62) show this is indemnified.

items.description: Supply of replacement kitchen table, comparable specification to the original
items.rationale: Replacement of furnishing item destroyed by insured event is covered at current value (7.1.1d, 4.2.6). Reference case 21 supports this price for a plain pine table of similar age and use.
Delivery of replacement furnishing item is covered (7.1.7h). Reference case 21 supports this.

items.description: Assembly of the new table (2 hrs)
items.rationale: Assembly of replacement furnishing item is covered (7.1.7h). Reference cases (21, 62) show this is indemnified, but usually as a flat rate; 2 hrs is reasonable.
Cleaning of the area where the replacement item is installed is covered (7.1.7h). Reference case 62 supports this.

items.description: Inspection of further furniture items stored in the garden for moisture
items.rationale: Inspection of unaffected items is not covered (7.1.8f). Reference cases (21, 65) show this is always excluded.
